name: @khorsheed/dsh-bundle-learning
description: 学习 preset（声明式）：挂载 library 的 agent 面（library_read/write/assess 三工具 + 精读教练 prompt 段 + library skill）于 preset 作用域——装上 library 得界面与数据面，加上本包得学习模式的模型能力

compat.notes: Declarative preset bundle: the only row is an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declaration (a loader row type that exists only on host 0.1.7-rc.1 and later — on 0.1.5 the bundle cannot mount at all). The `library-tool` composition entry the preset names (`@khorsheed/dsh-library/tool`) resolves from the installing profile's dependency closure — a DATA reference (dsh.references), never an npm edge, so installing this bundle alone leaves the preset row's grant inert (the library tools, the coach section and the skill stay absent) until @khorsheed/dsh-library is installed alongside; its core row stays global either way. The host tool rows the preset mounts (tool-ask-user / tool-web / tool-skill / the compaction group) are official packages present on every shipped line since 0.1.7-rc.1; the base is the standard preset dieted for a learning scene (no fs, no todo, no shell, no goal, no plan-mode, no delegation) — the writing-mode precedent. The skill face is a whitelist: skill-filesystem stays unmounted, so a learning session sees only skills explicitly scoped to it through the capability catalog's managed delivery, and with fs dropped a scoped skill's bundle files stay unreadable (only its SKILL.md reaches the model).
